content:
Answer the SINGLE question below about this repository. Cite file paths. If you cannot determine the answer, say so rather than guessing.
Start your answer with a line reading exactly "h03."

Question h03:
Users can authenticate through third-party identity providers. Which package defines the provider abstraction and which concrete protocol implementation ships?
Answer format: abstraction package; implementation package

h03.

Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo`, the common user-info shape returned by any provider — `internal/idp/idp.go:3`).

Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` — the OAuth2 protocol implementation (`oauth2.IdentityProvider`, `oauth2.NewIdentityProvider`, `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:19-27`), which is the only concrete provider shipped and is documented as implementing "the OAuth2 identity provider integration" (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:1`).
